resources.string: Paste a YouTube link. The app downloads the audio, drafts the karaoke timing in the cloud, then opens the editor — drag the words, then render the MP4.
Paste the lyrics here. Leave empty and the cloud will write them for you.
Transcript ready — fix the text in the lyrics box above, then tap “Run alignment”. The timing run reuses the separated audio, so it skips straight to alignment.
Logs copied — paste them in chat.
Nothing logged yet — try a download first.
Turn any song into a karaoke video
No jobs yet — start a song from Home.

The draft runs on your Modal backend (the same one the desktop app uses). This app can’t deploy one. Paste one line: your backend URL and your API key, separated by a space — like the KaraokeNow ReVanced setup.

Create a free Modal account, then paste the whole token command Modal gives you. Your own KaraokeGen backend is deployed into YOUR Modal account. The token is used once for that deploy and is never saved on this phone. Already set up before? It just reconnects to your existing server, usually under a minute. Brand-new account? The first build takes 5–10 minutes, once only.
No backend set up yet — paste your Modal token below.
The saved address is outdated — tap “Set up my backend” below to reconnect. It usually takes under a minute.
Paste your Modal token below and tap “Set up my backend”.
Paste the whole `modal token set …` command from Modal.
Your backend is ready — go back and tap Start.
Couldn’t reach the setup helper — check your connection and try again.
Couldn’t check for updates — check your connection and try again.
Tap Update to download and install. Your data and settings are kept.
Allow this app to install updates first, then tap Update again.
